You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.

ni ko kadan hakan bai bani mamaki ba domin kuwa vazu dauki rayukan yankin arewa a baki komai ba hakan ya kara tabbatar mana da mulkin kama karya ake yi mana allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe maga shegen da zai zo mana arewa campaign

output.original_text: ni ko kadan hakan bai bani mamaki ba domin kuwa vazu dauki rayukan yankin arewa a baki komai ba hakan ya kara tabbatar mana da mulkin kama karya ake yi mana allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe maga shegen da zai zo mana arewa campaign
output.joy: Ni ko kadan hakan bai bani mamaki ba, amma wannan ya nuna mana yadda zamu ci gaba da yin tunani akan arewa, da fatan Allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe, ina matukar jin dadin wannan.zhama!
output.sadness: Ni ko kadan hakan bai bani mamaki ba, amma ina matukar jin zafi ganin vazu na dauke rayukan yankin arewa, hakan ya janyo min tunanin mulkin kama karya da ake yi mana, Allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe kadan.
output.fear: Ni ko kadan hakan bai bani mamaki ba sau biyu, amma ina ji da matukar tsoro game da yadda vazu ke dauke rayukan yankin arewa, hakan yana nuna mana halin da muke ciki, Allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe, maganinsu ba mai kyau bane.
output.anger: Ni ko kadan hakan bai bani mamaki ba, gaskiya ya turawa jiki inaji, vazu sunyi bakin komai kan rayukan yankin arewa, hakan ya kara jaddada yanda mulkin kama karya ke faruwa, Allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe, mara kyau su duka!
output.surprise: Ni ko kadan hakan bai bani mamaki ba, da gaske ba na zata za a dauke rayukan yankin arewa haka a bude ido; hakan ya kara tabbatar mana da abubuwan da muke ji, Allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe, yana da kyau a yi canji!
output.disgust: Ni ko kadan hakan bai bani mamaki ba, amma abu ne mai matukar kayar da gwiwa ganin yadda rai ke tasiri a yankin arewa haka ba tare da wani kulawa ba, hakan ya tabbatar da mulkin kama karya da ke faruwa akansu, Allah ya kaimu lokacin zabe, wannan abun yana sa ni jin kadan.
